newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT -ADRs mixed, mull possible rate hike.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT -ADRs mixed, mull possible rate hike.

text.p: Foreign companies' American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) were mixed to higher on Friday as they absorbed the possibility the U.S. Federal Reserve would raise interest rates.
Decliners led advancers 235 to 205 in late morning among 806 ADRS. The index of ADRs rose 0.24 percent and volume was 34 million shares.
European ADRs are "now somewhat digesting the fact that there may be a rate hike and it might not be drastic," a trader said. "There is a little bottom fishing going on."
European ADRs also were helped by a weakening dollar. "That is helping ADRs about 1/8 of a point," a trader said.
Dutch shares bounced back from sharp losses on Thursday caused by option plays and fears of a U.S. rate increase at next week's Federal Open Market Committee meeting.
Among Dutch shares, Royal Dutch Petroleum Co rose 3-3/8 to 175-5/8 and Philips Electronics NV rose 3/4 to 43-5/8.
Israeli ADRs were mixed after a Palestinian suicide bomber in Tel Aviv killed two people, dealing a blow to faltering Middle East peacemaking efforts.
Asked why the shares had not dropped, a trader said, "I think it's a way of saying, 'Life goes on,' and they refuse to go lower."
Among Israeli shares, Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd rose 1-11/16 to 56-7/8.
Latin American traders reported quiet markets, with Mexico's stock market closed for a holiday. Telefonos de Mexico was up 3/8 to 40 in heavy trade in a rebound from selling on Thursday.
